sentences.text: The Boston Latin School is a public `` exam school '' in Boston , Massachusetts .	Latin	Latin	Boston	Boston	Massachusetts	Massachusetts	exam school	exam school	public	public education

The Public Latin School was a bastion for educating the sons of the Boston `` Brahmin '' elite , resulting in the School claiming many prominent Bostonians , Massachusetts citizens and New Englanders as alumni .
